classification.difficultyReason: Apply the taught cumulative-frequency median method, including zero frequencies and even counts.

content.prompt: Calculate the median for each frequency table.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}n&=2+2+2+2+5\\n&=13\\M_p&=\frac{13+1}{2}\\M_p&=7\end{align*}$$

Cumulative frequencies are $2,4,6,8,13$. The 7th value is $3$.

$$\text{Median}=3$$

$$\begin{align*}n&=5+5+5+5+5\\n&=25\\M_p&=\frac{25+1}{2}\\M_p&=13\end{align*}$$

Cumulative frequencies are $5,10,15,20,25$. The 13th value is $2$.

$$\text{Median}=2$$

$$\begin{align*}n&=20+0+0+0+0\\n&=20\\M_p&=\frac{20+1}{2}\\M_p&=10.5\end{align*}$$

Cumulative frequencies are $20,20,20,20,20$. The 10th and 11th values are both $0$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{0+0}{2}\\\text{Median}&=0\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}n&=0+20+0+0+0\\n&=20\\M_p&=\frac{20+1}{2}\\M_p&=10.5\end{align*}$$

Cumulative frequencies are $0,20,20,20,20$. The 10th and 11th values are both $1$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{1+1}{2}\\\text{Median}&=1\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}n&=0+11+10+0+0\\n&=21\\M_p&=\frac{21+1}{2}\\M_p&=11\end{align*}$$

Cumulative frequencies are $0,11,21,21,21$. The 11th value is $1$.

$$\text{Median}=1$$

$$\begin{align*}n&=0+0+10+11+0\\n&=21\\M_p&=\frac{21+1}{2}\\M_p&=11\end{align*}$$

Cumulative frequencies are $0,0,10,21,21$. The 11th value is $3$.

$$\text{Median}=3$$

$$\begin{align*}n&=0+5+5+10+10\\n&=30\\M_p&=\frac{30+1}{2}\\M_p&=15.5\end{align*}$$

Cumulative frequencies are $0,5,10,20,30$. The 15th and 16th values are both $3$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{3+3}{2}\\\text{Median}&=3\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}n&=10+6+6+0\\n&=22\\M_p&=\frac{22+1}{2}\\M_p&=11.5\end{align*}$$

Cumulative frequencies are $10,16,22,22$. The 11th and 12th values are both $2$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{2+2}{2}\\\text{Median}&=2\end{align*}$$
